chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn Hadith from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil from Zurara who said:
I asked one of the two Imams (peace be upon them) whether the Imam guarantees the prayer of the people, he said, 'No.'

key_terms.أَحَدَهُمَا: One of the two (referring to Imam al-Baqir or Imam al-Sadiq)

ai.seo_question: Does the Imam's prayer guarantee the validity of the congregation's prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* from the chain of Zurarah, this hadith clarifies that the Imam’s prayer validity is independent of the congregants', refuting the notion of automatic vicarious liability for their ritual errors. This distinction is crucial in Shia fiqh for determining individual accountability during congregational prayer, emphasizing that each follower must ensure their own compliance with prayer conditions.
